name: Azur
source:
A wise princess who has fallen for someone of a lower status. Azure is the first princess of her kingdom which has suffered the worst drought out of all the lands. She is in love with the young vice-captain of the kingdom’s army and even wanted him to become the future king. To do so, he must achieve a great feat to earn the kingdom’s trust, but until then, the two have decided to keep their relationship a secret. When the decision was made to wed Azure to a foreign country, the young vice-captain was powerless to stop it. Still madly in love with her beloved, Azure rejects the prince’s advances and her newlywed relationship kicks off to a bad start.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/princess-party/]Kagura Games[/url]]
